verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs say it integrates with alerting and monitoring tools to create incidents from alerts and can page on events from any monitoring tool. However, no evidence names Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Sentry, or shows a setup guide for any of them; the generic webhook event source is a building block, not a first-party integration. missing for 10: named first-party integrations for Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch and Sentry, per-tool setup documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Integrate with alerting and monitoring integrations to automatically create incidents from alerts
Alert and page your responders about events coming from any monitoring tool
